_meta.description: Offline static intelligence for Indiranagar, Bengaluru. All facts are sourced from named authoritative public sources. Values estimated without direct measurement are marked with lower confidence.

bmtc._source: BMTC published route maps at bmtcinfo.com and DULT Bengaluru origin-destination survey 2022-23
bmtc._limitations: BMTC does not publish GTFS. Route counts and headways are estimates from DULT survey data, not real-time. Many residents use metro or autos for local trips.
bmtc.routeCountNote: Approximate count of BMTC routes with stops in Indiranagar from DULT O-D survey 2022-23. Namma Metro (Purple Line) is the dominant rapid transit option for longer trips.

majorRoutes.description: Indiranagar – Airport via Outer Ring Road (Vajra AC)
Indiranagar – Kempegowda BS via MG Road

bmtc.majorRoutesNote: Representative list only; verify at bmtcinfo.com. Many commuters use Namma Metro (Indiranagar station) for journeys to Central Bengaluru and Whitefield.

peakHeadwayMinutes.description: Typical peak-hour bus headway at Indiranagar Metro Station and 100 Feet Road major stops

nammaMetro._source: BMRCL (Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited) published Purple Line station list and operational status. Indiranagar station is on the Phase 1 Purple Line (East-West corridor), operational since October 2011.
nammaMetro._limitations: Station operational status verified as of mid-2024. Verify current service status at bmrcl.co.in.
nammaMetro.line: Purple Line (Phase 1) — Baiyappanahalli to Mysuru Road

nearbyStations.name: Indiranagar
nearbyStations.note: Indiranagar station is within or at the edge of the Indiranagar OSM locality boundary. Walking distance for most of the locality.

commuteDestinations._source: OpenStreetMap road network geometry; off-peak routing estimates via OSM topology
commuteDestinations._limitations: Drive times are indicative only. Bengaluru peak-hour congestion routinely doubles or triples off-peak times. Many Indiranagar residents commute via metro to MG Road or Whitefield corridor.

water._source: BWSSB published zone maps and annual reports 2022-23; Karnataka Jal Jeevan Mission ward data 2023
water._limitations: BWSSB does not publish a real-time supply API. Individual street supply varies by pipeline zone and building connection status.
water.authority: Bengaluru Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
water.primaryWaterSource: Cauvery River — Stage III and IV treatment plants (T.K. Halli and Harohalli)
water.supplyFrequency: 3–4 days per week; typically 1–2 hours per supply cycle
water.sewageSystem: BWSSB underground drainage; Indiranagar is well-connected to UGD network
water.notes: Indiranagar is among the better-served East Bengaluru localities for Cauvery water supply. High-rise apartments typically have sump-and-overhead-tank systems that buffer supply gaps. BWSSB pipeline connection rate estimated 75–85% of occupied buildings.

electricity._source: KERC Annual Performance Review 2023-24; BESCOM annual report 2022-23
electricity._limitations: SAIDI and SAIFI are BESCOM-zone aggregates; individual feeder reliability is not separately published.

ndvi._source: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance NDVI computation over Indiranagar polygon via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Analysis July 2024 (dry season). Reference: Ranagaswamy & Devaraj (2019) Bengaluru NDVI ward analysis, Remote Sensing Letters Vol 10.
ndvi._license: Copernicus Sentinel data — free and open access under ESA Copernicus open data policy
ndvi._limitations: 10 m Sentinel-2 pixel; single dry-season composite. Seasonal NDVI varies ±0.08. 100 Feet Road's mature canopy trees may be partially captured in pixel aggregation.
ndvi.ndviClassification: Moderate urban vegetation — notable for mature tree canopy along 100 Feet Road and 12th Main; one of the greener localities in East Bengaluru
ndvi.comparisonContext: Bengaluru urban NDVI average ~0.20–0.28 (Ranagaswamy & Devaraj 2019). Indiranagar is near or above city average driven by the 100 Feet Road median plantation and residential plot gardens.

heatIsland._source: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (Band 10); USGS Earth Explorer. Analysis comparing Indiranagar polygon to rural reference ~30 km south, May 2024 (pre-monsoon).
heatIsland._license: Landsat data is in the public domain (USGS/NASA)
heatIsland._limitations: 30 m Landsat thermal resolution. Surface temperature ≠ air temperature. Single-date pre-monsoon analysis.
heatIsland.uhiClassification: Moderate urban heat island — mitigated by Indiranagar's relatively good tree canopy compared to adjacent commercial zones

ward._source: BBMP published ward delimitation 2022; Census of India 2011
ward.areaNote: Indiranagar spans BBMP East Zone wards; Ward 86 is the primary reference. The locality OSM boundary also includes parts of adjacent wards.
ward.populationNote: Approximate 2011 Census population for Indiranagar ward(s); actual 2024 population higher due to residential densification

complaints._source: BBMP Sahaaya grievance portal (FY 2022-23); iChangeMyCity public ward reports; Citizen Matters 2022-24
complaints._license: Public grievance portal data; attribution retained
complaints._limitations: Complaint counts reflect only registered grievances; under-reporting is significant.

totalComplaintsPerYear.note: Approximate registered complaints for Indiranagar ward(s), FY 2022-23

topCategories.note: Interior lanes and service roads reported; 100 Feet Road and CMH Road are generally maintained by BBMP.
Restaurant and pub clusters on CMH Road and 12th Main generate solid waste complaints.
Interior lanes in older residential sectors report non-functional streetlights.
Selected low-lying lanes flood during monsoon; less severe than east-of-ORR areas.
Footpath encroachment reported near commercial stretches on CMH Road.

crime._source: NCRB Crime in India 2022 — Bengaluru City district-level; Karnataka SCRB Annual Report 2022
crime._limitations: Crime data available only at city/district level. No open ward-level crime breakdown exists for Indiranagar.
crime.localityNote: Indiranagar is served by Indiranagar Police Station and Ulsoor Police Station (for some sub-areas). No public database provides FIR counts or crime rates at ward or locality level. City-level data is shown only as broader context.

internet._source: TRAI Broadband Report Q4 2023-24; Ookla Speedtest Global Index Bengaluru Q4 2023; ACT Fibernet, Airtel, Jio Fiber public coverage maps
internet._license: TRAI: public regulatory data; Ookla: research citations permitted
internet._limitations: TRAI data is circle-level, not locality-level.
internet.fiberAvailability: High — Indiranagar is well-served for fiber internet across its residential and commercial zones
